subject: VelocityWorks — growth fuel package authorization request
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: VelocityWorks — growth fuel package authorization request

Team — quick summary and ask below. Posting here so we have a clear exec record.

Customer: VelocityWorks (mid-market SaaS, ML-driven supply chain analytics). Primary buyer: Emma Torres (Head of Data).
Why escalate: they asked for a non-standard bundle that combines upfront free credits + a trial extension + a below-list committed rate. This exceeds my delegated discount/credit limits.

Proposal (what we would give if approved):
- $110k in free API credits (usable across hosted + dedicated evaluation) — accelerates model evaluation workload.
- 6-week trial extension (adds two full sprints for their integration team).
- 10% below our standard committed-rate on a 12-month minimum commitment (mix of usage + seat).

Why this matters:
- VelocityWorks is live with a 6-week POC that has demonstrated strong LLM throughput and a likely expansion pattern into multiple product lines in H2.
- Legal/Procurement timeline: they want terms and SOW this week to ship integration resources.
- Risk: credits + discount combined exceed sales tiers; without the package they will likely pause and evaluate alternate providers.

Recommended guardrails if approved:
- SOW signed and countersigned by Redwood and VW within 7 business days.
- 6-month minimum committed spend (not to exceed modeled negative LTV), with credits drawn down against that commit; unused credits expire at end of trial term.
- Finance to confirm chargeback/run-rate implications and set a one-time IO if necessary.
- Legal to push a short amendment limiting data export and adding SOC 2 clause.

Attachments: velocityworks-proposal-v3.pdf, pricing-sheet-2026Q4.xlsx, velocityworks-sow-draft.docx (see Drive link above).

Ask: Aditya/Marissa — request exec authorization to proceed with the package above (or guidance on limits). If approved I will send the formal approval language to VelocityWorks and route to Legal/Finance.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:05:12 -0800
Subject: Re: VelocityWorks — growth fuel package authorization request

Rishi — thanks for the concise write-up. I reviewed the proposal and had a quick chat with Emma this morning. A couple of practical notes:

- They have two integration engineers already ramped and a predictable token profile — the credits will likely be consumed within the extended trial, so the upside is real.
- My concern is the combined magnitude: $110k + 10% off for a year is beyond our normal topology. I recommend we trade the committed-term length rather than steepen the discount.

Suggested adjusted approval (minimal change path):
1) Approve $100k in credits (instead of $110k) to keep within our tier 3 credit authority.
2) Keep the 6-week extension.
3) Convert the discount to 7.5% off standard committed pricing for 12 months but require a 9-month minimum spend instead of 6.

If Aditya wants to keep your original ask (110k / 10% / 6-week), fine by me — I'm flagging Finance impact and asking Legal to prepare a short SOW amendment.

Marissa
VP Sales, West
Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:20:05 -0800
Subject: Re: VelocityWorks — growth fuel package authorization request

Approved with conditions — thank you for the clear framing. My decision rationale: VelocityWorks shows a credible expansion vector and the integration timeline is tight; this is the sort of early concession that can buy a multi-product expansion.

Approval (executive):
- Credits: APPROVED $110,000 in one-time evaluation credits
- Trial extension: APPROVED 6 weeks
- Committed discount: APPROVED 10% off standard committed rate for a 12-month period

Conditions (must be met before credits are released):
1) Signed SOW and Master Services Agreement countersigned by VelocityWorks within 7 business days.
2) Minimum 6-month committed spend explicitly documented in the SOW (Finance to verify projection and set an IO if needed).
3) Legal to approve standard data protections + SOC 2 clause.
4) Rishi to add a 30-day rollback clause if usage patterns materially differ from the projected profile (to protect unit economics).

Finance: Priya — please confirm you can absorb the one-time credit at this level and advise on the accounting path (contra-revenue vs. credit memo). Ops: loop in Billing to ensure credits map to the new account ID.

Rishi — once Legal confirms the amendment I authorize you to communicate the package to VelocityWorks and move the SOW to signature. Please keep me in the loop on any material changes.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
VP Sales
Redwood Inference

- I will get the internal BU signoff today and return the signed SOW by EOD Thursday.

If there are any timelines you need from us, call me directly at +1 415-555-0192.

Best,
